messages:
Zoe: publish blocked by regendiff on sample-onboard. looks like semver bumped because changelog-generator treated a reorder as an addition.
Ibrahim: paste the diff? hoping it9s ordering only.
Zoe: yep ordering-only. example:
```
- components/schemas/Device.yaml
- components/schemas/Session.yaml
+ components/schemas/Session.yaml
+ components/schemas/Device.yaml
```
Zoe: also saw a flaky test that mutates global retry config and leaks into the generated defaults on rerun.
cli-bot: regendiff job #2041: 2 ordering-only files, 1 test drift. deterministic: false
Ibrahim: short-term: add a deterministic-serialize flag to regen and set it in CI. medium-term: make changelog-generator ignore pure reorder hunks. long-term: upstream deterministic traversal in openapi-parser.
Zoe: can you push the CI change now? publish window in ~90m.
Ibrahim: pushed regen-ci: add `--deterministic-serialize`. also updated release-gate rule to ignore ordering-only diffs.
qa-bot: build #2042: regen re-run -> PASSED (no regendiff)
Zoe: nice. I'll open a follow-up PR to fix the flaky test (sandbox retry config + afterEach restore) and add a unit asserting serializer stability.
Ibrahim: opened gating PR to treat regendiff ordering-only -> no semver. merged CI hotfix branch.
Zoe: added onboarding note: "If initial regen diffs appear, re-run with `--deterministic-serialize` and file a regendiff ticket."
qa-bot: build #2045: full sample-onboard pipeline PASSED
Ibrahim: created ticket DEX-1200 to upstream deterministic parsing and DEX-1201 to improve changelog heuristics.
Zoe: PR for test fix is up. will monitor for one more run.
qa-bot: build #2048: all sample-onboard jobs PASSED
Zoe: closing thread 61 thanks everyone :tada:
